performance.verdict: Meta is the only converting channel; Google's $1,845 spend is structurally untracked.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — none show a completed event.
Google Ads consumed $1,844.93 over 28 days (LSA alone: $1,677.52) but GA4 records 0 conversions; 7 conversions in the ads UI are unverified — pixel is almost certainly not firing.
Meta delivered all 15 tracked leads at CPL $169.75 on $701.32 spend; 3-day signal (Sep 9–11) shows 4, 3 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 6–8) showing 1, 1, 2 — acceleration confirmed.

GHL shows 66 opportunities created vs 15 leads in Windsor — a 4:1 gap. Leads appear to be arriving but the pipeline source-tagging is unreconciled; this is an intake/CRM mapping issue, not an ads problem.
GBP dropped -32.35% week-over-week (105 actions over 28 days, last 3 series days show 0 actions each), while paid Meta is accelerating — organic visibility appears to be fading as paid ramps.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion pixel immediately — $1,844.93 spent with 0 verified GA4 conversions means LSA/Search is flying blind.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has consumed $1,844.93 over 28 days — $1,677.52 through the LSA campaign alone — with zero conversions recorded in GA4. The SOW required tracking to be wired and tested before go-live (milestone due July 31), and that milestone is overdue. Web/CRM team must install and verify the Google tag or GTM conversion event, then run a test lead end-to-end to confirm it fires. Success check: at least one confirmed Google conversion event visible in GA4 and the Google Ads UI by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Reconcile GHL pipeline source-tagging — 66 opportunities vs 15 tracked leads is a 4:1 gap that obscures true CPL and intake performance.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 66 opportunities created in the 28-day window while Windsor/analytics sources show only 15 leads — a 4:1 discrepancy. Nacer's team should audit pipeline source tags and confirm which entries are ad-driven vs. walk-in, referral, or duplicate contacts. This is a CRM mapping issue, not an ads volume problem. Success check: a reconciled breakdown by source submitted to Sohib by 2026-09-19, so CPL-per-channel can be calculated accurately.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL — 3-day lead acceleration is confirmed but baseline is only 15 leads; hold budget until pixel fix clarifies true blended CPL.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta's 3-day signal (Sep 9–11: 4 then 3 leads) is the strongest momentum in the account, with CPL at $169.75 on $701.32 spend. However, Google's pixel is unverified (F2), so the blended CPL is currently misleading — any budget shift toward Meta before the Google fix is confirmed would be premature. Re-check on 2026-09-19 after the pixel fix: if Google still shows 0 GA4 conversions and Meta CPL holds below $200, a budget shift will be the defensible next move.
